 Photo by: GoDucks.com Oregon-Nebraska Match at MKA Sold Out
 11/02/26 | Women's Volleyball
 VB Seating Map vs Nebraska VB Public Parking vs Nebraska Share: No. 12 Oregon hosts top-ranked Nebraska Saturday, Nov. 7, at 7 p.m.
 EUGENE, Ore. — When the No. 12 Oregon volleyball team hosts top-ranked Nebraska next Saturday, Nov. 7, in Eugene, the match will be played inside a sold-out Matthew Knight Arena. First serve of the Oregon-Nebraska match is set for 7 p.m. and will be aired on the Big Ten Network. In anticipation of a capacity crowd, several elements of the match day experience have been adjusted.
Doors will open at 5:30 p.m. and early arrival is encouraged especially for the general admission ticket holders. Fans can begin lining up no earlier than 4 p.m. and must be present; unattended items left to hold spots will be removed.
Once inside, reserved tickets are for Sec. 102-105 and 111-113 and UO students can sit in the usual Pit Crew seating in addition to Sec. 117-119 and 217-219, and lower level of Sec. 115-116.
Fans in general admission seating are asked to not leave space between groups to ensure all ticket holders are able to have a seat.
 Parking/Transportation Information 
A free shuttle service will begin at 5 p.m. running from Autzen Stadium, specifically picking up on Leo Harris Parkway by Entry 6 of the Moshofsky Center. Fans can park in the Moshofsky and Science Center lots. Click HERE for a map.
Fans utilizing the shuttle service will be dropped off at the North Entrance of Matthew Knight Arena. Return trips to Autzen Stadium will start approximately 20 minutes following the match and continue until the arena is clear.
Parking in the 13 th Ave. garage has been sold and will not be available unless previously purchased. Fans will not be able to purchase 13 th Ave. garage parking on site.
Additional parking will be available in campus lots ($10 cash only) and the Millrace garage ($12 credit card only).
 Mobile Ticket Information 
Fans should access and save their tickets to their mobile phones prior to the arriving at the arena. Visit www.goducks.com/mobiletickets for how-to information. The box offices will open 1.5 hours prior to the match for customer assistance.
For assistance ahead of match day, email tickets@uorgon.edu or call 1-800-WEBFOOT.
Fans will not able to buy tickets at the box office on the day of the match but may check for verified resale tickets via Ticketmaster .
 Clear Bag Policy 
 Bags must be clear and no larger than 12"x6"x12"; clutch size bags (6.5"x4.5") are also allowed
 One bag per person
 No large purses, camera bags, tote bags, diaper bags, mesh bags, tinted/colored/patterned bags
 Backpacks, fanny packs, drawstring bags must be clear
